sourceFile: 21. BRS 161016 PQC DATA checking Gauss Yoke_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft misidentifies the comparison and parses metadata as measurements, so it cannot be used as final evidence.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not Normal OK vs low Gauss groups.
Baseline and test conditions are explicit in source but omitted.
Key condition evidence from Test Gauss and average sheets is not used.
Many subResults treat model, line, shift, and labels as numeric metrics.
Outcome grouping omits SPL, impedance, THD, and NG status context.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Normal OK vs Low Gauss 419-459G vs Gauss 460-477G.
Use Test Gauss!5-7 as primary condition and status evidence.
Use SPL, impedance, and THD average headers/rows for measurement outcomes.
Remove metadata-derived numeric stats for model, line, shift, and labels.
Preserve date, line, model, shift, and gauss range as subgroup keys.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient and misgrouped; cite rows naming each condition and metric.
